name: Zingara
notes:
Header logo is two WebP images: emblem /images/logo.webp (2608x1632, alt 'Zingara Logo') and wordmark /images/Zingara.webp (1536x1024). Only WebP originals exist (.svg and .png versions return 404), so they are kept as .webp rather than renamed or converted. Site is dark throughout; the footer (#151310) reuses the same images, so there is no separate light version. Nav bar is #1c1a18 at 88% opacity. Accent is the 'ORDER NOW' button (#c8332a, text #f5edd8); Swiggy (#fc8019) and Zomato (#e23744) buttons use those platforms' colours. Headings: Cormorant Garamond; body: DM Sans; Kaushan Script is used for a menu-section script title. The page title reads 'White Biryani in Horamavu, Bangalore | Zingara'. Favicon: favicon.png and apple-touch-icon.png are both 2608x1632 (non-square, same image as the emblem); /favicon.ico is 404. Original image files are NOT included in this package: the build workspace cannot reach this site directly and the browser channel cannot transfer binary files. Run fetch_assets.sh (in the brand-assets root) to download the originals listed in sources.txt into this folder unchanged.
